page_title: Best Note-Taking App for Mac | Zoho Notebook

summary.name: Zoho Notebook for Mac
summary.one_liner: Zoho Notebook is a note-taking app for Mac that adds AI meeting transcription, menu bar quick capture, a Safari/share extension, and sync across devices.
use_cases: capturing quick ideas from the menu bar
clipping web articles and research for later
keeping private notes locked with Touch ID
summary.what_it_does: Converts audio notes and meetings into searchable text, with summaries, highlights, action items and timestamps. Lets you create, search and jump to notes from the menu bar. Saves articles, images, links and files from Safari or any app via share extensions and a Web Clipper. Supports PDF annotation, scanning documents and sketches via iPhone Continuity Camera, and opening multiple notes side by side. Notes sync across Mac, mobile and web when signed in with a Zoho account, and can be created and edited offline.
notable: Apple Intelligence and on-device intelligence for organizing, transcription and summaries
Menu bar quick capture and search
Continuity Camera scanning and Touch ID note locking
caveats: Premium upgrades are needed for additional storage and advanced features
Sync requires signing in with a Zoho account
